from pathlib import Path
from zipfile import ZipFile
import hashlib, shutil
archive=Path.home()/"Local/Research-Cloud/PR-248-hu200-200m-model/HU200-200M-M1-evidence-20261013.zip"
def sha(path):
    h=hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open('rb') as f:
        for block in iter(lambda:f.read(1024**2),b''):h.update(block)
    return h.hexdigest()
assert archive.stat().st_size==4132696783 and sha(archive)=="f3f169bd93e67d6b72d195747bff5989789ebd4a0eaafdaf4984af0481aef794"
destination=Path("results/retrieved/pr248-100000000-checkpoint-NEW")
destination.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
target=destination/"HU200-100000000.gz"
with ZipFile(archive) as z, z.open("HU200-100000000.gz") as source, target.open('xb') as output:
    shutil.copyfileobj(source,output,1024**2)
assert target.stat().st_size==759275650 and sha(target)=="f340b44cbaad923be4851cd7628f3513a937d900d7e5039dbabfea105ecfc2de"
print(target.resolve())
